# Journalism Format v1.1.14

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on easily formatting numbers, dates, and more.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [arraysToData](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/arraysToData.md): arraysToData function
- [camelCase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/camelCase.md): camelCase function
- [capitalize](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/capitalize.md): capitalize function
- [dataAsCsv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/dataAsCsv.md): dataAsCsv function
- [dataToArrays](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/dataToArrays.md): dataToArrays function
- [formatDate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/formatDate.md): formatDate function
- [formatNumber](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/formatNumber.md): formatNumber function
- [normalizeString](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/normalizeString.md): normalizeString function
- [prettyDuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/prettyDuration.md): prettyDuration function
- [printTable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/printTable.md): printTable function
- [round](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-format/v1.1.14/docs/functions/round.md): round function
